IC1: Male [OR] & female patients >= 18 and < 70 years of age
IC2: Positive HBeAg before starting NA treatment
IC3: Treated [AND] by a single NA (lamivudine [OR], adefovir [OR], entecavir [OR] or tenofovir) for 6 months to 5 years
IC4: Developed HBeAg [OR] seroconversion [OR] (HBeAg  negative [OR] and ant-HBe negative) with undetectable HBV DNA [AND] by PCR based assay [AND] on NA [AND] treatment.
IC5: Negative urine [OR] or serum pregnancy test (for women of childbearing potential) documented within the 24-hour period prior to the first dose of test drug. Additionally, all females must be using reliable contraception during the study and for 3 months after treatment completion
